title: Random nodes with positive weights: Richter-Tchakaloff rules and optimal positive quadrature
summary: We show that independent random points support exact quadrature rules with positive weights. For any $n$-dimensional space $V$ of integrable functions a constant multiple of $n\log n$ points sampled from a suitable density yields, with high probability, positive weights which integrate the functions in the space exactly. The weights stay close to the natural importance sampling weights according to the Lewis density with respect to $V$.
